categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in MEMS (Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems) chip process development and wafer manufacturing, along with semiconductor equipment sales and navigation product R&D and sales. It also engages in related software and hardware product agency sales and technical development services. The MEMS business includes process development and wafer manufacturing, serving various applications such as communications, biomedical, industrial automotive, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced MEMS manufacturing technologies including silicon through-via (TSV), glass through-via (TGV), wafer bonding, deep reactive ion etching (DRIE), and piezoelectric and magnetic materials. It employs microfabrication techniques integrating photolithography, etching, deposition, bonding, and plating to produce micro-scale mechanical, chemical, optical, and electrical structures. The company has developed standardized process modules (SmartBlock) to optimize production efficiency and cost control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leaders in photolithography, DNA/RNA sequencing, infrared thermal imaging, computing networks, metaverse, silicon photonics, AI computing, ICT, and new medical devices. The end markets served span communications, biomedical, industrial automotive, and consumer electronics sectors. The company also serves emerging MEMS design firms and startups transitioning from development to mass production.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major manufacturing facilities in Sweden and Beijing, China. It serves customers in North America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Oceania. The company maintains a dual domestic and international operational model to mitigate geopolitical risks and support global market demands.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on MEMS chip manufacturing and process development. It is a pure-play MEMS foundry providing wafer fabrication services and is expanding into downstream MEMS advanced packaging and testing services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding MEMS manufacturing capacity domestically and internationally, advancing core MEMS process technologies, and developing new MEMS product categories such as RF filters, resonators, micro-mirrors, gas sensors, biochips, and silicon photonics. The company emphasizes high R&D investment to maintain technological leadership and innovation in MEMS manufacturing and packaging.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through customized MEMS process development fees (NRE), wafer manufacturing services (foundry), and semiconductor equipment sales. The company operates on a direct sales model, providing tailored manufacturing solutions to global customers and selling semiconductor equipment primarily sourced from overseas.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes globally with IDM firms like Bosch, Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, HP, Panasonic, and foundry players such as Teledyne MEMS, TSMC, X-FAB, Sony, IMT (Atomica Corp.), and domestic competitors including Chiplink, Shanghai Advanced Semiconductor, Huahong Grace, China Resources Microelectronics, and Silan Microelectronics. It ranks among the top pure MEMS foundries worldwide, holding a leading position in the global MEMS foundry market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.3 billion, a 65.39% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 103.6 million, a 241.24% increase. Total assets reached RMB 7.26 billion, with steady growth in both domestic and international operations. The company maintains high R&D expenditure, accounting for over 27% of revenue, reflecting its growth and innovation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers globally competitive, high-precision MEMS manufacturing services with a comprehensive technology portfolio and extensive process development experience. Its dual-location manufacturing strategy ensures supply chain resilience and customer proximity. The integration of advanced MEMS process technologies, standardized process modules, and expanding packaging/testing capabilities provide customers with one-stop, high-quality MEMS solutions tailored to diverse and evolving market needs.
